key_stat: Pioneer in digital banking | ING Direct heritage | Fnality shareholder | Wholesale banking
summary: ING is a Dutch digital-first bank with strong wholesale banking franchise. Pioneer in digital banking (ING Direct). Fnality shareholder. Operations across Europe, Americas, Asia-Pacific. Key business: wholesale banking (lending, transaction services, financial markets), retail banking (Benelux, Germany, Australia). Technology: digital banking platforms, AI for credit risk, real-time payments.

business_segments.name: Wholesale Banking
business_segments.detail: Lending, transaction services, financial markets. Global corporate franchise.

business_segments.name: Retail Banking
business_segments.detail: Netherlands, Belgium, Germany, Australia. Digital-first. Mobile banking leader.

technology.ai: AI for credit risk, fraud, customer insights. Pace of change model.
technology.cloud: Cloud-native approach. Agile at scale (ING model widely copied).
technology.data: Customer analytics. Real-time risk. Transaction data.
technology.platforms: Digital banking platforms. ING model (agile/DevOps pioneer).

operating_model: ING agile model (squads, tribes, chapters) — widely copied. Digital-first. Lean operations. Fnality shareholder.
risks: ING has strong internal tech culture — less outsourcing
coforge_angle: NN TAL. ING is an agile technology pioneer but still needs vendor support for wholesale banking technology, platform engineering, regulatory compliance, and scaling.
